verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly documents '30 idiomatic SDKs' across languages/platforms, OpenFeature provider support, edge/Cloudflare SDKs, and a Relay Proxy for consistent flag delivery, and community evidence independently confirms a working mobile client SDK and consistent streaming/flag-download behavior across SDKs. Missing for 10: an explicit enumerated list of backend/web/mobile SDK names in the pack and independent hands-on cross-platform consistency testing (community notes mobile SDK's MAU-based pricing as a practical caveat, not a functional gap).
